events.name: Pittsburgh Penguins at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Bryan Rust and Yegor Chinakhov scored first-period goals and the Pittsburgh Penguins topped the Detroit Red Wings for the second time in three days, 4-1, on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryan Rust and Yegor Chinakhov send the streaking Penguins past the Red Wings, 4-1

events.name: Utah Mammoth at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Jesper Bratt had a goal and an assist to lead the New Jersey Devils to a 4-1 win over the Utah Mammoth on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jesper Bratt's goal, assist lead the Devils to a 4-1 victory over the Mammoth

events.name: Buffalo Sabres at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — The Columbus Blue Jackets scored three times in the first period, including once short-handed, and beat Buffalo 5-1 on Saturday, snapping the Sabres’ league-leading 10-game win streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blue Jackets snap Sabres’ 10-game win streak in 5-1 rout

headlines.description: — Owen Tippett and Nick Seeler each had a goal and an assist to lead the Philadelphia Flyers to a 5-2 win over the Edmonton Oilers on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tippett and Seeler help Flyers beat Oilers 5-2 for 4th win in 6 games

events.name: Montreal Canadiens at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Jordan Binnington made 25 saves for his first shutout of the season, Jonatan Berggren and Robert Thomas scored and the St. Louis Blues beat the Montreal Canadiens 2-0 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Binnington makes 25 saves for 1st shutout of the season, Blues beat Canadiens 2-0s

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Nikita Kucherov scored his 20th goal of the season on a second-period power play and added four assists, Darren Raddysh had a hat trick and the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the San Jose Sharks 7–3 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nikita Kucherov, Darren Raddysh carry the Lightning past the Sharks, 7–3

headlines.description: — Ottawa defenseman Thomas Chabot scored twice and the Senators beat Winnipeg 4-2 on Saturday night, handing the Jets their ninth straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chabot scores twice as the Senators hand the Jets their 9th straight loss, 4-2

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Matthew Schaefer scored twice, including at 4:11 of overtime, and the New York Islanders beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schaefer scores 2nd goal of game in OT to give Islanders 4-3 win over Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Nick Foligno scored in the sixth round of a shootout to give the Chicago Blackhawks a 3-2 victory over the Washington Capitals on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blackhawks drop Capitals to 0-5 in shootouts, beat Washington in 6 rounds for a 3-2 win

headlines.description: — Brock Nelson scored two power-play goals in the first 7 1/2 minutes of the third period and the Colorado Avalanche rallied past the Carolina Hurricanes 5-3 on Saturday night for their 10th consecutive victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nelson scores twice in 3rd as Avalanche rally past Hurricanes, 5-3

headlines.description: — Nicolas Hague broke a tie with 28 seconds left, Erik Haula scored twice in a 1:33 span in his 800th NHL game and the Nashville Predators beat the Calgary Flames 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nicolas Hague breaks tie with 28 seconds left, Predators beat Flames 4-3

events.name: Minnesota Wild at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Quinton Byfield had a goal and an assist, Samuel Helenius scored his first goal of the season, and the Los Angeles Kings beat the Minnesota Wild 5-4 in a shootout on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kings give up lead in 3rd period for 2nd straight game but recover for 5-4 shootout win over Wild

headlines.description: — Fraser Minten scored his second goal of the game 4:41 into overtime to cap a huge homecoming as the Boston Bruins beat the Vancouver Canucks 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Minten scores twice in huge homecoming to lift Bruins over Canucks 3-2 in OT
